Hexalith.Platform.name: Platform 1.5.0
Hexalith.Platform.body:
Add current-source package qualification for the EventStore 4.1.0 and Tenants 7.0.4 dependency tuple. Bind generated catalogs and private owner artifacts to their measured source, tool and package bytes. Preserve historical public-cohort controls.

Qualify the current source and the same changed code against the legacy dependency tuple through the Platform tuple preflight, alongside all catalog binding checks.

### BREAKING CHANGES

* Rich search indexing with package dependencies now
requires a canonical revision and original refresh proof. Reconcile
retained legacy ingestion obligations before rollout; unknown
admissions stay blocked.

build: merge current main into diagnostic review

original guard commits in the review branch history.
